change.scope: HTTP metadata versioned image URL, actual PNG response/immutable cache, NoData transparency, renderer revision changes URL while all geospatial/solver identities remain identical

findings: Offline DEM image URL includes v=stone-v2 as a real browser cache key as well as an internal render-version directory; cached v0 green PNG does not mask the new neutral image.

DEM surface enforces explicit asset ID and hash, full-grid statistics and bounded <=73x73 samples; NoData stays null. Registered asset changes are rejected and separate runtime roots cannot access each other.

Three-dimensional mesh omits every quad touching a null corner. Projection curves skip unknown/out-of-range samples; the UI states display-only sampling, exaggeration and ground projection boundaries.

Flight profiles read original Plan Snapshot, content hash, original resource/type/cargo and bound DEM. Rebuilt route mismatch is rejected; time and energy reuse solver leg/leg_values. Vertical datum is not relabeled AMSL. Up to 240 display samples do not certify clearance.
Version routes are GET-only, preserve immutable contents and snapshot, sort descending, and return null dates because VersionRow never stored timestamps.

Town context extracted from original HTML retains exact checked hash, original WGS84 coordinates/OSM IDs and 1829 roads/95 water surfaces/101 waterways/166 places/1 reference boundary. It is labeled historical non-solver context, not live imagery or official boundary.
Native Map source guards and canceled/instance checks prevent unmounted stale async work. Per-component event listeners/ResizeObserver/markers and native Map are removed during cleanup.

Reviewed existing source-matching 1440 and 390 map screenshots: neutral DEM/waterways, point dots and credits visible; mobile long names are ellipsized or may extend to clipping edge, and complete names remain in point selection/table/title. No horizontal page overflow was recorded.

existing_browser_evidence_review.satellite: Existing browser reports ERR_NETWORK_ACCESS_DENIED; no successful satellite browser screenshot claimed. Standard-shell single-tile HTTP 200 JPEG only confirms upstream reachability. Explicit failure fallback is separately covered.

scope_notes: Shared local background promises are session cached; a failed initial background fetch does not automatically retry in the same JS session. Reload retries. DEM analysis remains separately retryable via React Query. This is a non-blocking local static-asset availability limitation.

MapCenter region metadata banner indicates an available context package before geometry finishes loading; native map data-context only becomes true after the geometry source is added. The static count panel is package inventory, not current visible feature count.
No browser preview database was changed; no original source inputs, algorithm, API DTO, production code or generated contracts were changed in this audit.
